Diagnostic only, do not modify any file. Using search_code, find every call site of checkSeal / SealStatus / DIVERGED_BODY (or equivalent seal-check import) across src/*.ts (especially src/memory-store.ts, src/memory-log.ts, src/memory.ts, src/sessions.ts, src/cli.ts). Produce a list of every operation that REFUSES on a diverged seal, each with: operation name, file path, line range, and the guard condition/error it raises. Also explicitly note any call sites that check the seal but do NOT refuse (e.g. only warn), so they are not mis-listed as refusing.

claims.text: memory/.seal.json path is defined by sealPath() joining memoryDir with SEAL_FILE = ".seal.json"

sealFile() writes memory/.seal.json: computes sha256 digest of the file's current content and stores it under the file's relative-path key, or deletes the key if the file no longer exists (writeSeal persists atomically via tmp file + rename)
sealContent() also writes memory/.seal.json directly from an in-memory content string (used when content is generated rather than already on disk)
writeSeal() performs the actual atomic write: writes to a temp file then renames it over the real seal path

checkSeal() is the detection function: it computes sha256 of the given content and compares to the stored digest for that key; no stored entry -> 'unsealed' (and seals it silently); matching digest -> 'sealed'; mismatching digest -> 'diverged'

digest() is sha256(content) hex-encoded via node:crypto createHash; this is the only hash/comparison primitive used, applied to the full text content of each memory file (MEMORY.md, USER.md, projects/<slug>/MEMORY.md), keyed by sealKey() = path relative to memory/
DIVERGED_BODY is the constant message shown in place of file content when checkSeal returns 'diverged': "[BLOCKED: modified out of band — agentik memory reseal to accept]"

src/memory-seal.ts defines checkSeal(file, content, home) around line 102, returning a SealStatus ('sealed'|'unsealed'|'diverged'); DIVERGED_BODY is a constant message at line 117 used when a seal has diverged.

src/memory-store.ts imports checkSeal, DIVERGED_BODY, sealContent, sealFile, sealKey from ./memory-seal.ts (line 6) and uses checkSeal inside readSealed (line 272) to compute the status of a memory file.
docs/THREAT-MODEL.md and CLAUDE.md both document memory/.seal.json as a sha256-based tamper-evidence mechanism (docs/THREAT-MODEL.md L35, CLAUDE.md L87).
